title: Gnomengarde

location.name: Gnomengarde
location.description: A rock gnome warren built into a cliff beside a waterfall, ruled jointly by two gnome kings. One king, Gnerkli, has been driven mad by a whispering magic item — and a mimic has crept into the warren's treasury, wearing the shape of a chest.
location.environment: gnome warren, cliffside tunnels, whimsical machinery

read_aloud: Gnomengarde clings to a cliff beside a silver waterfall, its tunnels alive with clockwork whimsy — chiming doors, self-stirring pots, tiny mechanical birds. But something is wrong. The gnomes whisper of their king Gnerkli, who has locked himself away and raves at a voice only he can hear. And in the treasury, a fat wooden chest sits where the gnomes swear no chest used to be. Three jellyfish-like creatures drift down a side tunnel, and a voice speaks gently inside your mind: 'Beware. Two dangers here, little warm-bloods. The mad king... and the thing that is not a chest.'

encounters.description: The mad king Gnerkli. He clutches a whispering magic wand and won't be reasoned with easily. Resolve via persuasion, trickery, or (last resort) subduing him — NOT killing. The flumphs telepathically aid the party with warnings and lore.

encounters.trigger_condition: a PC opens or touches the 'chest' in the treasury

enemies.position: disguised as a treasure chest (False Appearance)
enemies.special: Adhesive — grapples the first hand that touches it (escape DC 13), then bites. Cannot pursue (speed 15).

encounters.tactics: The mimic is a gotcha: it adheres and grapples the greedy PC, biting for acid while allies scramble to free them. It can't chase — a ranged party can whittle it safely. Perception/Investigation vs its Stealth spots the too-new chest first.

npcs.name: King Gnerkli
dialog_hooks: Mad rock gnome king clutching a whispering magic wand
Can be calmed (Persuasion/Insight), tricked, or subdued — the gnomes beg you not to kill him
Cured/subdued, he rewards the party with gnomish devices and a Wand of Magic Detection

npcs.name: The Flumphs of Gnomengarde
dialog_hooks: Peaceful telepathic drifters who warn the party about the mimic and the mad king
Provide lore about Cryovain and the region via telepathy

loot.location: reward from the grateful gnomes if Gnerkli is saved
the treasury (once the mimic is dealt with)

skill_checks.success: Talk Gnerkli down / separate him from the whispering wand without violence.
skill_checks.failure: He raves and flees deeper, or the gnomes turn wary.

skill_checks.success: Spot the mimic — the 'chest' that is too new, faintly breathing.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): mimic gets max HP (58); add a second 'chest' mimic if the party is strong. Mostly SOCIAL + a gotcha — a change of pace. Flumphs are ALLIES (telepathy), not enemies. Do not let the party murder Gnerkli — the reward hinges on saving him. 3+ interactables: whimsical clockwork (distractions/tools), the waterfall (escape/wash off mimic acid), the whispering wand (a cursed temptation).
